paper: MM-ARC: Multimodal Adaptive Routing of Capital with Robustness-Audited Strategy Pools
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored single-U.S.-market, monthly reconstruction of MM-ARC's aligned views, regime-conditioned expert pools, RABO admission, and simplex capital routing; not the missing Qwen3-VL adapters, RL router, or native 62-instrument result.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Cutoff-aligned multimodal observations feed a softmax capital router over four expert exposures before common feasible portfolio projection and after-cost settlement.

Aligned chart, numerical, and deterministic technical-text views support trend, reversal, breakout, and exposure-control experts in market-shared, regime-conditioned strategy pools with bounded semantics.

RABO admits five candidates per pool using within-update ranks of benchmark exceedance, 5% lower-tail performance, median behavior, local stability, and turnover, then converts pool robustness into router evidence.
All pool audits use past-only blocks; expert signals are routed continuously rather than hard-selected and are evaluated only after shared portfolio and cost constraints.

routing_and_audit_policy.regime_rule: bull when trailing six-month cap-weighted market return exceeds 5%, bear below -5%, otherwise sideways
routing_and_audit_policy.regime_sparse_fallback: use the full 120-month audit history when fewer than 12 observations share the current regime
routing_and_audit_policy.benchmark_candidate: the primary candidate of the same expert
routing_and_audit_policy.turnover_proxy: mean absolute month-to-month change in candidate score for securities observed in consecutive months
routing_and_audit_policy.stability_proxy: negative standard deviation of purged-block mean RankIC
routing_and_audit_policy.router_rule: softmax of trailing admitted-pool mean RankIC plus the RABO robustness tilt across four experts
routing_and_audit_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths provide the common feasible portfolio and cost layer

preserved_elements: cutoff-aligned multiple views derived from one observed data source
trend, reversal, breakout, and exposure-control experts
continuous simplex capital routing rather than a hard expert switch
five admitted strategies per expert-regime pool
past-only robustness audits across multiple blocks
the exact five RABO rank terms and 0.30/0.30/0.15/0.15/-0.10 weights
pool robustness evidence tilting expert capital
a shared common portfolio and cost layer after expert routing
approximated_elements: JKP price, trend, turnover, volatility, and safety ranks replace OHLCV arrays
numeric composites and sign summaries replace Qwen3-VL chart and technical-text encodings
six fixed typed formulas per expert replace Bayesian-optimization proposals
RankIC block distributions replace native after-cost candidate portfolio scores
signal-rank changes replace projected-portfolio turnover inside RABO
a deterministic softmax replaces the missing actor-critic router
one U.S. market with 12 pools replaces five markets and 60 shared pools
invented_elements: the exact six candidate formulas for each expert
the 120-month audit window and 12-observation regime minimum
the chart and technical-summary proxy construction
the router temperature and robustness tilt
the common monthly stock score mapping
